title: Om gutten som gikk til nordavinden og krevde melet tilbake
world: Old rural Norway, long ago, in the first cold weeks of winter. The boy and his mother live in a small, grey, weathered log cottage with a turf roof; beside it stands a little stabbur, a storehouse on posts with a steep wooden stair up to its door. Far away, on top of a high, snowy mountain with a few wind-bent spruces, lives the North Wind. By the road home lies the inn, a big, low log house with a lantern at the door and a goat shed behind. The magic cloth is a square white linen tablecloth with a red woven zigzag border, and the swapped one looks exactly the same. The stick is a knobbly old stick of pale birch wood, about as long as the boy is tall. The flour is carried in a small grey sack.
palette: The first cold weeks of winter: a thin, new layer of snow on frozen ground, hoarfrost on every twig, blustery wind and cold blue-grey skies with fast grey clouds; deep snow on the North Wind's mountain. Indoors: warm, golden firelight and candlelight against the cold blue light at the windows.

cast.name: Gutten
cast.description: En hjelpsom og modig gutt som vil gjøre det rette for å skaffe mat til moren sin.
cast.look: A small, skinny boy of about nine with a narrow, pale face, cheeks rosy from the cold, big sticking-out ears, bright blue eyes, a determined little frown and white-blond hair that sticks up in tufts. He wears a baggy grey knitted jumper that is too big for him, patched dark-brown trousers, thick grey wool stockings, worn leather boots and a long brown knitted scarf.
cast.portrait: Background: the little stabbur in the frosty yard.

cast.name: Moren
cast.description: En gammel, sliten mor som gutten passer på, og som blir lettet når de endelig får hjelp.
cast.look: A thin, tired old woman of about sixty-five, a little stooped, with a long, gentle, deeply lined face, tired grey eyes, a thin mouth and one eyebrow often raised in doubt. Her grey hair hangs in one thin braid over her shoulder. She wears a faded plum-coloured wool dress, a darned brown knitted cardigan, a long patched linen apron and wooden clogs.
cast.portrait: Background: the snug, dim cottage kitchen.

cast.name: Nordavinden
cast.description: En kraftig, men rettferdig vind som kan virke brummete, men som gir gutten magiske gaver når han ber om hjelp.
cast.look: A huge, grumbling old man made of swirling white and pale-grey clouds, with no legs, only a long, whirling tail of mist and snowflakes. He has a broad face with puffed-out round cheeks, icy-blue eyes, big bushy white eyebrows, a thick moustache made of snow and a long, frosty white beard that streams away in the wind, and big, soft cloud hands. Snowflakes and tiny icicles glitter in his hair.
cast.portrait: Background: a snowy mountain top above the clouds.

cast.name: Gjestgiveren
cast.description: En lur vert som prøver å bytte til seg de magiske tingene, men lærer å gjøre opp for seg.
cast.look: A tall, gangly innkeeper of about fifty with a long, narrow face, a much too wide, toothy smile, small glittering eyes, a long pointed chin and oily black hair twisted into one big curl on his forehead. He wears a wine-red waistcoat with shiny brass buttons over a white shirt with rolled sleeves, a long blue-and-white striped apron, dark breeches and a wide black leather money belt that jingles with coins.

cast.name: Den magiske bukken
cast.description: En liten bukk som kan lage gull når gutten sier de rette ordene.
cast.look: A small, sturdy billy goat about as big as a large dog, with a shaggy snow-white coat, a light-grey face with a little pointed grey beard, bright amber eyes with slot-shaped pupils, short, curved, ridged horns, a stubby tail, neat black hooves and a red leather collar hung with two small brass bells.
cast.portrait: Background: the snowy yard in front of the inn.

places.name: the Cottage Kitchen
places.look: A small, low log room with dark, smoke-stained walls and a ceiling of rough beams. A stone fireplace with a black cooking pot glows in the corner, a plain wooden table stands under a small frosted window, a bench runs along the wall, and a broom and a water bucket stand by the door. A worn rag rug lies on the floorboards. Poor, but tidy and cosy.

places.name: the Inn Parlour
places.look: A big, low-ceilinged parlour in an old log inn, with dark timber walls, a large open fireplace with a crackling fire, two long plank tables with benches, a small corner table under a window, an iron lantern hanging from a beam, pewter mugs on a shelf and a heavy plank door to the frosty yard. Warm, smoky and golden.

cover.prompt: On a windswept, snowy mountain ridge under a cold blue-grey sky, the Boy stands with his feet planted wide and his fists on his hips, looking up at the enormous face of the North Wind, which fills the sky above him, cheeks puffed out and eyebrows bristling, blowing a gust of snowflakes at him. The Boy's scarf and hair stream out behind him, but he doesn't budge an inch.
cover.caption: Gutten går helt opp på fjellet for å si ifra til Nordavinden.
cover.alt: Gutten står på en snødekt fjellrygg med hendene i siden og ser opp på Nordavinden. Nordavinden fyller hele himmelen, blåser ut kinnene og sender snø mot ham.

illustrations.anchor: SSSSSSUUUUUUSJ! Nordavinden tok nesten gutten også.
illustrations.prompt: A blustery winter morning in the frosty farmyard: on the steep wooden stair of the little stabbur, the Boy hugs a small grey sack of flour with both arms and leans back with all his might, his feet lifting off the step and his hair and scarf blown flat. The North Wind swoops down out of the grey sky with his cheeks puffed out, blowing hard, and a long white veil of flour streams away from the sack across the snowy yard.
illustrations.caption: SSSSSSUUUUUUSJ! Nordavinden tar nesten gutten også.
illustrations.alt: Gutten står på stabburstrappa og klamrer seg til melsekken, mens Nordavinden blåser så beina hans nesten letter. Melet fyker av gårde som et hvitt slør over gårdsplassen.

illustrations.anchor: «Jeg har ikke noe mel», sa Nordavinden.
illustrations.prompt: High up on the snowy mountain top, among a few wind-bent spruces and above a sea of clouds, the huge North Wind leans down with a grumpy but kind face and holds out a neatly folded white tablecloth with a red border in his big cloudy hand. The Boy, tiny in front of him, stands knee-deep in snow and reaches up with both hands to take it, his eyes shining. Snow tumbles off the spruce branches as the North Wind grumbles.
illustrations.caption: «Jeg har ikke noe mel», sier Nordavinden. «Men du skal få en duk.»
illustrations.alt: Høyt oppe på det snødekte fjellet rekker den store Nordavinden fram en sammenbrettet, hvit duk. Gutten står i snøen og strekker seg opp for å ta imot den.

illustrations.anchor: Den som gapte mest, var gjestgiverkona.
illustrations.prompt: In the Inn Parlour in the evening, the magic cloth is spread on the small corner table, covered with pancakes, meatballs and a kransekake, a tall tower of golden almond rings with white icing, so tall that the Boy stands on a chair to see the top of it, beaming. Beside the table the innkeeper's wife, a small, skinny woman with a sharp nose and a yellow kerchief, gapes with her hands clasped and greedy, shining eyes. At a long table, two travellers stare with open mouths.
illustrations.caption: Kransekaka er så høy at gutten må stå på stolen for å se toppen.
illustrations.alt: Gutten står på en stol ved et bord fullt av pannekaker, kjøttkaker og en kjempehøy kransekake. Ved siden av står gjestgiverkona og gaper, og to reisende stirrer.

illustrations.anchor: Moren la haka i hånda og så på ham.
illustrations.prompt: A close view across the table in the Cottage Kitchen: the white cloth with the red border lies smoothed out on the bare wooden table, completely empty. The Boy stands beside it and stares at it in disbelief, his arms spread wide. Across the table the Mother sits with her chin in her hand and one eyebrow raised, looking at him with a doubtful 'hmm'. Cold blue light at the frosty window.
illustrations.caption: Ingen pannekaker. Ingen kransekake. Ikke en eneste rosin.
illustrations.alt: Hjemme ligger duken helt tom på bordet. Gutten stirrer overrasket på den, og moren sitter med haka i hånda og ser tvilende på ham.

illustrations.anchor: Gjestgiveren sto ved døra med et altfor stort smil.
illustrations.prompt: In the Inn Parlour, a shining heap of gold coins lies on the floorboards at the Billy Goat's hooves, with a few more still rolling away. The Boy kneels beside the goat, patting its head and beaming. In the doorway behind them stands the Innkeeper with a much too wide smile, rubbing his hands together, his eyes glittering as brightly as the gold. Warm firelight gleams on the coins.
illustrations.caption: Kling! Klang! Klirr! Og ved døra står gjestgiveren med et altfor stort smil.
illustrations.alt: En haug med blanke gullpenger ligger på gulvet foran bukken, og gutten klapper den på hodet. I døra står gjestgiveren, gnir seg i hendene og smiler altfor bredt.

illustrations.prompt: A wide view of the Cottage Kitchen: the Billy Goat stands in the middle of the floor looking completely innocent, with a few small, round brown pellets on the floorboards behind it. The Boy scratches his head, red-faced and embarrassed, while the Mother marches in from the corner with a broom, her lips pressed together and one eyebrow raised. Funny, not gross.
illustrations.caption: Plopp, plopp, plopp! Men gull er det ikke. Moren henter kosten.
illustrations.alt: Bukken står midt på gulvet i stua og ser uskyldig ut, og bak den ligger noen små, runde kuler. Gutten klør seg i hodet, og moren kommer med kosten.

illustrations.prompt: Night in the Inn Parlour, lit by the glowing embers and one lantern: the Innkeeper leaps over a bench with both hands clutching the seat of his trousers and his mouth wide open in an 'ow!', gold coins jingling in his belt, while the old birch stick hops through the air after him all by itself. The Boy, still lying on his bench, props himself up on one elbow and grins. A second, identical stick lies dropped on the floor. Slapstick, nobody hurt.
illustrations.caption: «Au! Au, au!» roper gjestgiveren og hopper over benken.
illustrations.alt: Om natta hopper gjestgiveren over en benk og holder seg bak, mens en kjepp danser etter ham i lufta. Gutten ligger på benken sin og smiler.

illustrations.anchor: Der sa han de magiske ordene.
illustrations.prompt: In the Cottage Kitchen, warm with firelight, a big wooden bowl of steaming porridge with a pool of melting butter in the middle has appeared on the white cloth on the table. The Boy stands beside it with both arms thrown up in triumph. The Mother leans over the bowl with her hands clasped and her eyes wide with wonder, believing it at last. The old birch stick leans quietly in the corner.
illustrations.caption: Vips! En stor, rykende bolle grøt. Endelig!
illustrations.alt: På bordet hjemme står en stor bolle rykende grøt på den hvite duken. Gutten strekker armene i været, og moren bøyer seg over bollen med store øyne.
